day_encounters.our_name: Service Outage: The Break Room Goes Dark

f01-z06.narrator_line: Notice: the Break Room is offline. The vending terminal is closed. Resting there is no longer supported. The Green Room remains available.
f01-z06.read_aloud: SERVICE OUTAGE. Terminal offline. Vendors offline. Break Room rest unsupported.

voice_lines.intro: SERVICE OUTAGE. Terminal offline. Vendors offline. Break Room rest unsupported.
voice_lines.twist: The fridge light clicks off. In the dark, a lone sandwich sits with a name taped to it. Nobody dares.
voice_lines.win: Last meal eaten, last crumb shared, last credit spent. Go on. The building isn't going to hold your hand.

flavor: The Break Room has gone to lunch and will not return. The Green Room stays open, for reasons of mercy and liability.
